_about: Grid Paper #9 (r43, garrikedits, score 9) v2, 8 Oct 2026, matched frame by frame: a dark, cool blue-purple talking head with small white sans lead words and ONE white serif-italic hero (one or two words glow cyan), cut with white GRID-PAPER pages where a grey shaded object (brain, handcuffs) sits under a mixed editorial stack (small sans lead, huge bold sans key, serif-italic tail), and lightly graded colour b-roll that carries the captions. Sound like the ref (demucs): a slow bed ~9.5 dB under the voice (head-bang, closest match 5.5), a soft 2-3 kHz whoosh on each page change.
_round3: round 3 tweak tried (6 Oct, measure v2): punch cadence every 12 s scored 34.1 vs 36.7; reverted to every 4.5 / minGap 2.2

director.style: Grid Paper #9: a cool, dark talking head and clean white grid-paper idea pages with a shaded object under bold editorial type. Calm, smart, premium.
director.pages: 2-4 stack scenes per 20 s: bg paper, grid true, iconImg true, icon = one engraving that fits the idea (brain, lightbulb, magnifier, gears, handshake, chess...), iconSize 520 (the picture sits BELOW the words, visible from the first frame), lines: lead (role s) the small words, key (role k) the ONE big word, tail (role t) the big serif-italic rest; all words spoken while the page is up. inSfx paper-quick. in cut, out cut.
director.cutaways: 1-2 image scenes in COLOUR (the ref's b-roll is warm/cool colour, lightly graded), captions true, grade contrast(1.1) saturate(0.85) brightness(0.86), in cut, inSfx whoosh-2.
director.captions: captions.heroes: the idea word of each phrase (white serif italic); captions.glowWords: 1-2 payoff words (cyan glow). Mixed case.
director.sound: music head-bang -9.5 dB; paper-quick on grid pages, whoosh-2 on cutaways; nothing on captions.
